quests.title: The Order Calls
text: A village librarian slips you a note: the Arcane Order is recruiting, and the entrance fee is ten books and a quill. Bring them to Archmage Orrin Vael in Reece.

lines: Ten books and a quill! Marvellous! Where are my spectacles?
Ah. On my head. Welcome, apprentice.

rewards.name: Guide to the Schools
lore: Eight schools. Orrin has underlined the dangerous ones.

lines: The Arcane Order is recruiting. Discreetly.
Bring ten books and a quill to Archmage Orrin in Reece.

quests.title: An Honest Table
text: Orrin despises guesswork. Build an enchanting table ringed by fifteen bookshelves, and enchant your first tool.

tasks.title: Build an enchanting table ringed with bookshelves
Enchant your first tool at the table

quests.title: Reroll the Fates
text: Orrin's test: produce a book with two enchantments he names, using the table's re-roll, without wasting more than ten levels.

lines: Unbreaking and Efficiency on one book, wasting no more than ten levels.
Fortune favours the frugal.

tasks.title: Make a book with Unbreaking and Efficiency

quests.title: The Priest's Blessing
text: Priests of the Order wander between villages. Find one, trade with him for a healing potion and hear about the undead stirring beneath old graves.

tasks.title: Find a village priest

lines: Something stirs beneath the old graves. Sister Agathe hunts it.
Take a healing draught. Notch's blessing.

quests.title: Ink and Parchment
text: Craft an inscription table, mix common ink, and copy a scroll for the library's records.

quests.title: Essence of the Arcane
text: Break down unwanted scrolls and enchanted gear into arcane essence, and gather twenty: the Order's currency.

quests.title: A Book of One's Own
text: Orrin won't let an untested caster anywhere near the library's rare books. Bind a copper spellbook, inscribe your first spell, and prove your control on a target dummy until it comes cleanly.

tasks.title: Practise on the dummy until it comes cleanly

quests.title: The Study
text: Every mage needs a study. Build one with wisewood bookshelves, a brazier, a pedestal for your book and a scroll rack.

tasks.title: Build a study

quests.title: The Pyromancer's Tower
text: Orrin's old rival keeps a tower near the badlands. Find the Pyromancer Tower and ask its pyromancer to teach you, politely.

tasks.title: Find the Pyromancer Tower

lines: Orrin sent you? Politely? Hm. I teach those who can take a fireball.

quests.title: Trial by Fire
text: The pyromancer only teaches those who can take a fireball. Duel him with spells until he yields.

encounter.name: The Pyromancer
lines: Ha! Let's see what the old windbag taught you!
Enough! You've earned it.

quests.title: School of Fire
text: The pyromancer will teach you, once you've earned it. The dead keep clawing out of the old graves around her tower, and only fire lays them to rest for good.
Craft a fire rune, scribe a fire spell, and cleanse twenty of the restless dead with flame.

tasks.title: Scribe a fire spell onto a scroll
Lay twenty of the dead to rest with fire

quests.title: The Apothecarist
text: Deep in the mangroves lives the Apothecarist, who trades potions for odd ingredients. Find the hut and trade her a stack of mangrove roots and spider eyes.

tasks.title: Find the Apothecarist's hut

lines: Roots and eyes. You've done your reading.
Take this elixir. It toughens the skin.

quests.title: The Poisoned Traveller
text: A courier staggers out of the swamp, poisoned, withered and slowing by the minute. Keep him alive with what the Apothecarist taught you: brew a cure for each ailment in turn, before the next one sets in.

encounter.name: Poisoned Courier
lines: Poison... then withering... I can't feel my legs.
You cured me? Thank you.

tasks.title: Brew a cure for each ailment

quests.title: Hags' Pantry
text: The Apothecarist won't go near the witches, but she wants their stock. Visit a witch hut and bring back a witch's redstone, glowstone and a bottle of her brew.

tasks.title: Find a witch's hut

item.name: Witch's Brew
item.tooltip: A bottle of her own stock

quests.title: The Lost Apprentice
text: Pip, Orrin's apprentice, ran off with three of his books. Track her to a wizard tower in the old forests, solve the warded door, and talk her into coming home.

tasks.title: Find the wizard tower

lines: Orrin sent you? I only borrowed the books.
Fine, I'll go home. I'm keeping the hat.

quests.title: A Hundred Sparks
text: Orrin is raising a ward of runes around Reece against whatever is draining the old places. Every spell cast by a sworn member of the Order feeds a spark of its echo into the ring.
A hundred sparks will wake it. Cast them anywhere; the ward hears.

tasks.title: Feed the ward a hundred spells

quests.title: The Bubbling Cauldron
text: Orrin's long nights need better ink and a stronger brew. Mix uncommon and rare ink in an alchemist cauldron, and brew a casters' tea for him.

tasks.title: Mix uncommon ink for Orrin's scrolls
Mix rare ink for his best work
Brew a casters' tea for his long nights

quests.title: The Arcane Anvil
text: Scrolls are weak alone and strong merged. Forge an arcane anvil, merge two scrolls into a stronger one, and add an upgrade orb to your armour.

tasks.title: Forge an arcane anvil
Merge two scrolls on the anvil

quests.title: The Mithril Vein
text: A better spellbook needs mithril. Mine it deep in the deepslate, smelt it and weave mithril cloth for the binding.

tasks.title: Mine mithril deep in the deepslate
Smelt the mithril
Weave mithril cloth for a spellbook binding

quests.title: The Cryomancer's Tower
text: High in the frozen peaks stands the Cryomancer's tower. Climb to it through the snow, with the cold biting at you.

tasks.title: Climb into the frozen peaks
Reach the Cryomancer's tower

quests.title: Thaw the Cryomancer
text: The Cryomancer has gone cold in every way and attacks anyone who climbs his stairs. Melt him with fire.

tasks.title: Defeat the Cryomancer at the top of his stairs
Melt his ice with fire spells

quests.title: School of Ice
text: The tower's frost leaves materials behind. Collect frozen bones and permafrost shards, craft an ice rune, and bind an ice spellbook.

tasks.title: Collect frozen bones from the peaks
Collect permafrost shards
Craft an ice rune
Bind an ice spellbook

quests.title: The Ice Spider Den
text: A furled map points to the Ice Spider den. Kill its brood and take one unbroken ice spider egg.

tasks.title: Kill the den's brood

search.found: An unbroken egg, cold as a stone.

tasks.title: Search the den for an unbroken egg

quests.title: A Cold Delicacy
text: Pip dares you to cook an ice spider egg and serve it to Orrin without telling him what it is.

lines: Cook an ice spider egg. Serve it to Orrin. Don't tell him.

tasks.title: Take Pip's dare
Cook an ice spider egg

lines: A cold delicacy? Splendid. Is that... egg? Delicious.
tasks.title: Serve the dish to Orrin

quests.title: The Impaled Icebreaker
text: A ship is skewered on an iceberg, its crew frozen solid. Climb aboard and bring the captain's sea chest back intact.

tasks.title: Climb aboard and open the captain's chest

quests.title: Lightning in a Bottle
text: Storms hold more than rain. Catch three bottles of lightning while one rages, and craft a lightning rune from them.

tasks.title: Wait for a thunderstorm to break
Call the storm down with lightning spells
Catch three bottles of lightning
Craft a lightning rune

quests.title: The Evoker Fort
text: Orrin's stolen tome, the Archevoker's logbook, is kept in the Evoker Fort. Scout it and learn the guards' rotations.

tasks.title: Scout the Evoker Fort
Watch the guards' rotation from cover

lines: I came as soon as I could. What did you see?
Good. Remember it.

tasks.title: Report what you saw to Orrin

quests.title: The Unseen Thief
text: Get into the fort and take the logbook without any illager seeing you. Caught once, you start again. Pip lends her trick for the first try, and the scarf she borrowed from Orrin once you're out.

tasks.title: Take Pip's invisibility elixir

lines: Don't be seen. If anything hurts you, you start again.

tasks.title: Cross the fort unseen
Take the logbook from the vault

quests.title: In the Illagers' Hand
text: The Archevoker's logbook is written in a cipher. Translate it with Orrin's help, page by page. It names the catacombs where the dead are being raised.

tasks.title: Bring the untranslated logbook

lines: A cipher, page by page. Hold the lamp.
It names the catacombs. The dead are being raised.
tasks.title: Translate the cipher with Orrin

quests.title: The Archevoker
text: The Archevoker summons fangs and vexes in the fort's great hall. Defeat him, if you want his robes.

tasks.title: Defeat the Archevoker in the great hall

quests.title: Five Schools
text: Orrin will not call you a mage until you can show him five schools. Cast each once in front of him: fire, ice, lightning, nature and holy.

tasks.title: Cast a fire spell for Orrin
Cast an ice spell for Orrin
Cast a lightning spell for Orrin
Cast a nature spell for Orrin
Cast a holy spell for Orrin

quests.title: Room for More
text: Five schools need a bigger book. Bind a gold spellbook and add a spell-slot upgrade so it holds every school you know.

tasks.title: Bind a gold spellbook
Make the rune that adds a spell slot

quests.title: The Graves Below
text: Sister Agathe reads the translated logbook and goes pale. She leads you to an old graveyard where the stair down to the catacombs was found.

lines: The dead are being raised. The logbook names the stair.
Come. I'll show you the graves.
tasks.title: Show the logbook to Sister Agathe
Follow Agathe to the graveyard with the stair

quests.title: The Catacombs
text: Descend into Iron's catacombs and clear its corridors of the risen dead. Only holy magic lays them to rest.

tasks.title: Descend the stair into the catacombs
Lay the risen dead to rest with holy magic

quests.title: The Necromancers
text: Necromancers keep raising the dead faster than you can kill them. Hunt three and take the bone key one of them carries.

tasks.title: Hunt the necromancers raising the dead
Take the bone key one of them carries

quests.title: Shards of the Phylactery
text: The bone key opens the catacombs' vaults, where pieces of a phylactery are hidden. Gather the shards for Agathe before anyone else does.

tasks.title: Gather the phylactery's shards from the vaults

quests.title: The Dead King
text: In the heart of the catacombs the Dead King sits on his throne. Wake him and end his reign. Agathe waits at the stair.

tasks.title: End the Dead King's reign on his throne

quests.title: The Forbidden School
text: Orrin forbids blood magic. Pip insists you should understand it to fight it. Craft a blood rune and cast a blood spell in secret.

tasks.title: Craft a blood rune in secret
Cast a blood spell where Orrin cannot see

quests.title: The Crimson Enchanter
text: An enchanting table grown from crimson wood stands somewhere in the Nether. Enchant a book there with your own levels.

tasks.title: Bring a book to enchant at the crimson table
Spend your own levels at the crimson table

quests.title: The Ancient Map
text: The phylactery points to a fire-forged citadel in the Nether. Find or buy the furled maps to the Nether citadel and the ancient battleground.

lines: Furled maps? I sell two. Citadel and battleground.
tasks.title: Ask a cartographer for the furled maps
Find or buy the Nether citadel's map
Find or buy the ancient battleground's map

quests.title: The Nether Citadel
text: Reach Iron's Nether citadel among the bastions, find the cinderous vault and read the inscriptions about the Flamebearer.

tasks.title: Reach the Nether citadel among the bastions

search.found: Inscriptions about the Flamebearer, in the cinderous vault.

tasks.title: Read the inscriptions in the cinderous vault

quests.title: The Ancient Battleground
text: Ancient Knights still keep watch on a Nether battlefield. Find it and defeat its Keepers, the citadel's armoured guardians.

tasks.title: Find the Nether battlefield
Defeat the Keepers who guard the field

quests.title: Cinder and Soul
text: Collect eight cinder essence from the citadel's guardians and the cinderous vaults. The forge needs a soul of fire.

tasks.title: Collect cinder essence from the citadel's guardians and vaults

quests.title: Pyrium
text: Forge pyrium ingots from cinder essence and netherite, the metal the Flamebearer's followers worked.

tasks.title: Forge pyrium ingots from cinder essence and netherite

quests.title: Robes of Netherite
text: Upgrade your mage armour into a full netherite mage set.

tasks.title: Upgrade a netherite mage hood
Upgrade a netherite mage robe
Upgrade netherite mage leggings
Upgrade netherite mage boots

quests.title: Eldritch Pages
text: Orrin says the void holds a school older than fire. Recover an eldritch manuscript from the End and learn one eldritch spell from it.

tasks.title: Find the manuscript shrine in the End
Recover an eldritch manuscript
Cast an eldritch spell learned from it

quests.title: Legendary Ink
text: Brew legendary ink in the alchemist cauldron and inscribe a legendary scroll of your own choosing.

tasks.title: Brew legendary ink in the alchemist cauldron
Inscribe a legendary scroll of your own choosing

quests.title: The Flamebearer's Trail
text: Bring Orrin, Agathe and Pip together in the library tower with the citadel inscriptions and the phylactery shards. Together they work out who the Flamebearer was, and why his echo still burns.

tasks.title: Bring the phylactery shards

lines: The shards and the inscriptions. Together at last.
tasks.title: Gather Orrin in the library tower

lines: The Flamebearer's echo still burns. We know why.
tasks.title: Gather Agathe in the library tower

lines: I knew it! I borrowed the right book!
tasks.title: Gather Pip in the library tower

quests.title: The Statue of Tyros
text: Craft the Tyros Statue from pyrium and raise it on an altar far from Reece, the summoning place Orrin chose.

tasks.title: Craft the Tyros Statue from pyrium
Raise it on an altar far from Reece

quests.title: Echo of Tyros
text: Wake the Echo of Tyros, First Flamebearer, and lay the flame to rest, with Orrin, Agathe and Pip watching from a safe distance.

tasks.title: Lay the Echo of Tyros to rest

quests.title: The Flamebearer's Codex
text: Orrin hands you his life's work to finish: bind a legendary spellbook with a page from every school you've mastered, and the Order names you its next Archmage.

tasks.title: Bind a legendary spellbook
Cast a fire page
Cast an ice page
Cast a holy page
Cast an eldritch page

lines: My life's work, finished. The next Archmage.
tasks.title: Be named the Order's next Archmage by Orrin

choice.name: The Flamebearer's Codex
lore: Every school has a page in it.

choice.name: The Flamebearer's Staff
lore: It remembers the flame's first word.
